name: Poured concrete bulkhead with a cap and weep holes: most of Ray Hubbard's developed shore
in_game: HouseKit.cpp's lot bank (bBulkhead): today a plain wall and a kerb-like cap; after Nov 21 this piece replaces it (Track I)
real: A vertical poured (or precast panel) wall, 0.6-1.2 m showing above the pool, a 300 mm cap poured on top a little proud of the face, PVC weep holes just above the pool every panel so the fill drains. Panel joints, form-tie marks, pinholes. Dark run-off under each weep hole, a silt stain band and a pale scum line, olive algae below the pool, a slick at the waterline.
